summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 8 bug fix (removal of the redundant COPY/MOVE mode-indicator from the top toolbar) plus regression checks on toolbar, Settings, Shortcuts and Categories modals. All 7 requested checks passed. No console errors, no error elements, no unused-import warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking pre-existing eslint warning remains: App.js line 103 'appliedIcons' conditional could change useMemo deps every render (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) — consider wrapping in its own useMemo.
App.js is a very large single file; consider splitting toolbar/modals into modules (>700 lines guideline).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: [data-testid='mode-indicator'] returns null (removed). Toolbar row 1 intact: Edit, compare-1/2/3, auto-rate-btn, open-rename, open-contact (Sheet), open-category-manager, toggle-batch, open-settings, show-help all visible. Settings modal opens with Store Mode section and mode-copy/mode-move present and closes on Escape. Shortcuts modal ('Keyboard Shortcuts') opens via show-help and closes on Escape. Category Manager opens. grep confirms 'MoveRight'/'CopyIcon'/'Move/Copy mode indicator' absent from App.js; webpack compiles with only the pre-existing appliedIcons eslint warning. File System Access API folder picker still not automatable, so photo-loading flows remain untested.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: a visual COPY/MOVE status div styled like a button (data-testid=mode-indicator) appeared clickable but had no handler. Fix removed the div and its now-unused lucide-react icon imports; the actual setting remains controllable via Settings > Store Mode. Verified removal and no regressions.
